quotes.quote: Query for multiple packages (by either package and version or git commit hash) at once.
Returns vulnerability ids and modified field only.
The response ordering will be guaranteed to match the input.
However, a querybatch request may return results with a next_page_token for only a few of the total queries.
An individual query within the queryset returns more than 1,000 vulnerabilities
The entire queryset returns more than 3,000 vulnerabilities total
To get the next page of results, your next request should specify page_token only for the queries that returned next_page_token.
